final: WITH filtered AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) as purpose_avg FROM `order` WHERE amount >= 2802 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(purpose_avg) as overall_avg FROM filtered) SELECT f.k_symbol, f.purpose_avg, f.purpose_avg - o.overall_avg as exceeds FROM filtered f CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE f.purpose_avg > o.overall_avg ORDER BY k_symbol
